dialogues.speaker: Roswitha
dialogues.text: May the Anemo Archon guide him safely home...

dialogues.speaker: Roswitha
dialogues.text: Yes, for my father... He's a merchant who travels between Mondstadt and Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Roswitha
dialogues.text: He sends letters home every so often, always claiming that everything's fine... but I just can't set my mind at ease until I see him return from the frozen north with my own eyes...

dialogues.speaker: Roswitha
dialogues.text: After all, the nation under the Tsaritsa's rule isn't always a welcoming place for a merchant...

dialogues.speaker: Roswitha
dialogues.text: Goodbye. May the tradewinds bring you good news.
